cur-fossil-big-bone-lick.dateNote: In 1739 French soldiers under Charles Le Moyne de Longueuil picked up mastodon bones at this salt lick in Kentucky. Thomas Jefferson later had them dug. The bones are from the last Ice Age, under 0.1 million years old.
